name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – After § 4 – Am 1
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section VI – European Economic and Social Committee
part_text: 4 a. Observes a 4,1 % increase in the final budget for 2023 compared with 2022 that follows a 5,1 % increase for 2022 compared with 2021; is concerned by these constant increases;
